agent.name: Close agent
does: Compares what people say about the close with the ledger and subledgers
Reruns a check when a decision changes its input
Drafts journal entries for a person to post

channels.name: rev-check
channels.topic: How the revenue check is built

catchUp: September was locked on 8 Oct, business day 6.
September revenue includes ¥42.7m delivered in October.

exceptions.title: Close length
exceptions.summary: The CFO says the group closes in five working days. September locked on business day 6.

replies.author: controller
replies.text: Five is Japan. The group needs a sixth day for consolidation.

resolution.log: Group close is business day 6; Japan’s is 5.

exceptions.claim: The CFO says the group closes in five working days.
exceptions.evidence: Sep 2026 was locked on 8 Oct 2026, business day 6, not 5.

exceptions.title: Europe on plan
exceptions.summary: FP&A says Europe is on plan in euros. H1 sales were 5.7% under budget; profit was above it.

replies.author: fpaAnalyst
replies.text: Agreed. The board pack now says sales are under plan and profit is above it.

resolution.log: Europe: sales 5.7% under plan, profit above. Board pack wording corrected.

exceptions.claim: FP&A says Europe is on plan in euros.
exceptions.evidence: Kasane Europe’s H1 external sales were €22.55m against a budget of €23.92m (5.7% under). Equipment was 18.2% under. Profit is above plan; sales are not.

exceptions.title: Revenue cut-off
exceptions.summary: Invoice INV-KJP-2609-00363 is dated 30 Sep but was delivered 2 Oct, so ¥42.7m of revenue is in the wrong month.

replies.author: controller
replies.text: Logistics confirms it left Tsukuba on 1 Oct. The cut-off review missed it.

resolution.log: Revenue cut-off: INV-KJP-2609-00363 moved to October. September revenue down ¥42.7m.

exceptions.claim: The controller says the Sep 2026 cut-off was clean.
exceptions.evidence: INV-KJP-2609-00363 (¥42.7m net) is dated 30 Sep 2026 but delivered 2 Oct 2026. Revenue belongs to the next month.

exceptions.title: Duplicate payment
exceptions.summary: KUS entered supplier invoice MFL-58821 twice and paid $48,216.40 both times.

replies.author: apLead
replies.text: The duplicate check compares the description too. "June" and "Jun" got past it.

replies.author: apLead
replies.text: Midwest Freight has agreed to credit $48,216.40 against the next invoice.

resolution.log: Duplicate payment: $48,216.40 to be credited by the supplier.

exceptions.claim: AP says the system blocks a duplicate supplier invoice number, in every entity.
exceptions.evidence: KUS entered supplier invoice MFL-58821 twice (API-KUS-2607-00007 and API-KUS-2607-00011), $48,216.40 each, and paid both.

exceptions.title: Self-approved entry
exceptions.summary: JE-KUK-2608-00055 moved £18,400 from advertising to prepaid expenses. The same person created and approved it.

replies.author: controller
replies.text: Fiona has reversed it in October, and the UK approval rule now blocks self-approval.

resolution.log: Self-approved entry: JE-KUK-2608-00055 reversed; self-approval now blocked in KUK.

exceptions.claim: The controller says every manual journal has a different approver, enforced group-wide.
exceptions.evidence: JE-KUK-2608-00055 (KUK, 31 Aug 2026) moves £18,400 from advertising to prepaid expenses. The same person, E3003, created and approved it. Whether it was over their limit needs the employee master, which isn’t in this material.

exceptions.title: Credit limit
exceptions.summary: US credit says Great Lakes Duplicating Supply was within its limit until August. It was over $600,000 in 7 earlier months.

replies.author: usCredit
replies.text: Agreed on the history. Legal decides on recovery by 30 Oct, and nothing changes until then.

exceptions.claim: US credit says Great Lakes Duplicating Supply was within its credit limit until August.
exceptions.evidence: Its balance was over the $600,000 limit in Sep 2025, Nov 2025 and every month from Mar 2026 to Jul 2026. The last payment arrived 21 Jul 2026.

hero.question: September is locked. Where should the ¥42.7m correction go?
hero.basis: The policy puts revenue in the month of delivery. It doesn’t say whether a locked month is reopened.

options.label: Reopen September
options.description: Reverse the invoice in September and rebook it on 2 Oct. H1 is right for the 6 Nov earnings release.

options.label: Keep September locked
options.description: Post nothing. List the ¥42.7m for the auditors' interim review, and the year to date is right from October.
